evidence.observed_facts: The full 2027 calendar year is covered by the statutory list. Substitute workdays (áthelyezett munkanapok) are set by ministerial decree under 102. § (5) by 31 October of the preceding year; no 2027 decree was found in the Magyar Közlöny as of 2026-11-24, so no substitute day is claimed. A secondary Hungarian calendar page read on 2026-11-24 states that the 2027 work-order decree had not appeared by 2026-11-12, and that no 2027 public holiday falls on a Tuesday or Thursday, so past practice would leave nothing to relocate; it counts 253 working days. That is a secondary reading, not the decree, so the substitute-day answer stays unknown.

verification_questions: Read the 2027 work-order decree when it is published and add any substitute workday; until then no substitute day is claimed.

currency_assumptions: Native prices are HUF, or EUR where the operator publishes in euros. The USD comparison uses the MNB official mid-rate of 2026-11-24: USD 1 = HUF 337.97; EUR 1 = HUF 369.57.
A published net price has 27% VAT added for comparability unless the page states that the price is gross; the gross and net figures are kept in price_detail.

Hourly base USD figures model eight billed hours without implying availability. An hourly estimate is included in programme_costs only for a verified 09:00–17:00 or 09:00–21:00 window. These are budget estimates, never quotes.
The soft budget is USD 5,000; exactly 5,000 is not over budget and cost is never a gate.

alcohol.quote: szeszesital alkalmi árusítása esetén az illetékes vámhatósághoz, rendörkapitánysághoz szükséges bejelenteni az árusítás helyét, idejét
alcohol.source_title: Alkalmi árusítás bejelentése — helyi önkormányzati nyomtatvány (Tura)

translation_review.gloss: For occasional sale of spirits, the place and time of sale must be notified to the competent customs authority and police department.
translation_review.review: Decision-bearing words (alkalmi árusítás, bejelenteni, vámhatóság, rendőrkapitányság) were read against the Hungarian; the form is a municipal template, so it evidences the notification path rather than a national statute.

value.observed_rule: Occasional sale of alcohol requires a notification to the customs authority and the police, on top of the event organizer's other permits.
value.unknown: Whether a private event with free drinks and no sale needs any permit beyond the venue's own licence, and who applies if the venue does not hold one.
value.venue_level: Per-venue alcohol_service claims record only what the venue publishes (in-house bar, exclusive caterer, or unknown).

verification_questions: Confirm with the venue and the district notary whether free beer at a private 50-person event needs a separate permit.

food.quote: A vendéglátás regisztrációja minden olyan természetes személyt vagy gazdálkodót érint, aki Magyarország területén vendéglátással foglalkozik. A Nébih-hez be kell jelenteni az ügyfélre és a tevékenységre vonatkozó adatokat nyilvántartásba vétel céljából.

translation_review.gloss: Registration of catering affects every natural person or business that carries on catering in Hungary; the client and activity data must be reported to NÉBIH for registration.
translation_review.review: Read through the provider's extraction because the NÉBIH portal is a JavaScript app; the sentence is a registration duty, not a permit for a specific event.

value.observed_rule: Catering is a registered food-business activity in Hungary; the operator or caterer must hold the NÉBIH registration.
value.unknown: Whether a one-day external caterer needs its own registration at the venue, and how drop-off food is treated.
value.venue_level: Per-venue food_service claims distinguish in-house, exclusive caterer and external catering.

verification_questions: Confirm the caterer's NÉBIH registration and whether the venue accepts external catering for this room.

language.quote: Magyarországon a hivatalos nyelv a magyar.

translation_review.gloss: The official language in Hungary is Hungarian.
translation_review.review: Short statutory sentence; the gloss was checked word by word on 2026-11-24.

value.observed_rule: Hungarian is the official language of the state; the law does not require a private, English-language conference to be conducted in Hungarian.
value.venue_level: Every assessed operator publishes English event pages; staff and AV language capability remains a per-venue question.
